stockManagementSystem.overview: Dual stock tracking: physical for GST, logical for non-GST

removeStock.safeguard: Ensures stock never goes below 0 for GST

commonErrors.cause: Stock deduction on GST firm challan

keyBusinessRules.rule1: Each user can have GST and Non-GST firm variants, accessed by separate tokens
keyBusinessRules.rule2: Stock management differs: GST uses physical_stock (enforced), Non-GST uses logical_stock (soft)
keyBusinessRules.rule3: Sale challans must have label_id for discount matrix application
keyBusinessRules.rule4: Purchase challans dont need label and don't automatically convert to bills
keyBusinessRules.rule5: Bills can only be created from sale challans or as standalone documents
keyBusinessRules.rule6: Bill amount = challan amount + transport_charge - return_amount
keyBusinessRules.rule7: Payment status calculated: due (balance > 0), paid (balance = 0), overpaid (balance < 0)
keyBusinessRules.rule8: Multiple payments can be recorded against one bill until balance reaches 0
keyBusinessRules.rule9: Returns restore stock (GST) and reduce bill/challan amount
keyBusinessRules.rule11: All monetary amounts rounded to 2 decimals with proper rounding
keyBusinessRules.rule12: Bill/Challan numbers auto-generated per user+is_gst combination
keyBusinessRules.rule13: Contact balance auto-updated from bill/return operations
keyBusinessRules.rule14: Bank-type payments require valid bank_id in user's bank list
keyBusinessRules.rule15: Sessions track device info and last_active timestamp for security
keyBusinessRules.rule16: Subscription expiry checked via cron job; inactive users auto-deactivated
keyBusinessRules.rule17: CASHBOOK and BANKBOOK are auto-created book contacts on user registration
keyBusinessRules.rule18: Automation rules trigger challan-to-bill conversion based on conditions

apiEndpointSummary.protectionLevel: All endpoints (except registration/login) require JWT token + role validation
